summary: Iteration 3 tested: audit-tout endpoint, document expiration + rappels endpoint, emoji/em-dash cleanup, frontend UI for AuditReport modal + Documents expiration input + Home rappels card. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (POST /api/simulations/{id}/auditer-tout returns full report with score_global/verdict_global/couleur/docs_analyses/docs_manquants/points_forts/points_faibles/total_requis/docs_uploaded/procedure/date_audit/utilisateur; POST /api/documents accepts date_expiration and persists it; GET /api/documents/rappels?jours=90 returns docs expiring within 90 days with correct urgence enum (expire<0, critique<=30, attention>30) and filters out those beyond 90 days; /api/pays drapeau all empty; /api/forum/categories no emojis; /api/simulations/pays drapeau all empty; 404 on unknown sim audit). Frontend: admin login OK; scanned Landing/Home/Register/Documents/AntiScam/Forum/Admin for emojis+em-dash — zero found; Home has data-testid=home-rappels card (visible when expiring docs exist, tested via rappels created earlier); Documents page has data-testid=doc-expiration-input, and doc-exp-{id} badges render on docs with dates; SimulationDetail shows detail-audit-btn, clicking opens modal with audit-start button, then after ~10s the audit-result appears with 1 audit-doc-* entry (passeport) + 6 docs manquants + audit-download button visible. AI audit endpoint completed in <90s and download button correctly present.
critical_code_review_comments: data.py FORUM_CATEGORIES 'nom' fields all start with a leading space (e.g. ' Canada, Études') — leftover from emoji removal. Should trim leading space for cleaner UI text.
server.py grew to 754 lines — consider splitting AI/audit/admin/forum into separate router modules.

GET /api/documents/rappels is defined BEFORE DELETE /api/documents/{doc_id} (different methods so no conflict), but if a future GET /api/documents/{doc_id} is added, place it after /rappels to avoid path collision.

auditer_dossier_complet iterates docs sequentially with await for each Gemini call — for a full dossier of 7 image docs this could hit 30-60s. Consider asyncio.gather for parallel analysis, or streaming progress to client.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed docs with date_expiration (20d, past, 100d, 45d) on admin account for rappels testing — safe to leave. Reused existing simulation for audit test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter3 features verified end-to-end. Audit endpoint reuses _analyser_document_ia and takes 5-30s per image doc — use timeout>=90s. Emoji/em-dash cleanup confirmed on all 8 main pages. Reusable test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter3_features.py. Minor cosmetic: forum category names have leading space after emoji removal.
